newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel mutual funds post positive returns in July.
newsitem.headline: Israel mutual funds post positive returns in July.

text.p: Israel's mutual funds posted positive real returns in July as a result of rising share prices and the positive trend in the bond market, Meitav Investments and Securities said in a report on Sunday.
Meitav said that its mutual fund general index rose by a high 5.2 percent in July, with most of the funds attaining real positive returns.
Since the beginning of the year Meitav's mutual fund general index rose by 25 percent, with all the funds attaining real positive returns.
Meitav attributed July's rise of the funds' general index to the strong stock market, which continued to rise amid higher volumes even after a high June consumer price index.
Prices of CPI-linked bonds which rose an average 2.7 percent in July also contributed to funds' positive returns, Meitav said.
